name: HIPAA Security Rule
description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act — Security Rule for protecting electronic protected health information (ePHI). Applies to covered entities and business associates.

controls.title: Security Management Process
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations. Includes risk analysis, risk management, sanction policy, and information system activity review.

controls.title: Assigned Security Responsibility
controls.description: Identify the security official responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures required.

controls.title: Workforce Security
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of its workforce have appropriate access and to prevent those who do not have access from obtaining access.

controls.title: Information Access Management
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to ePHI that are consistent with the applicable requirements of subpart E (Privacy).

controls.title: Security Awareness and Training
controls.description: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of its workforce (including management).

controls.title: Security Incident Procedures
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents including identifying and responding to suspected or known security incidents.

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.description: Establish and implement, as needed, policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence that damages systems containing ePHI.

controls.title: Evaluation
controls.description: Perform a periodic technical and non-technical evaluation that establishes the extent to which an entity's security policies and procedures meet the requirements.

controls.title: Business Associate Contracts
controls.description: A covered entity may permit a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit ePHI on its behalf only if the covered entity obtains satisfactory assurances.

controls.title: Facility Access Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed.

controls.title: Workstation Use
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation.

controls.title: Workstation Security
controls.description: Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access ePHI, to restrict access to authorized users.

controls.title: Device and Media Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain ePHI into and out of a facility.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain ePHI to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.

controls.title: Audit Controls
controls.description: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use ePHI.

controls.title: Integrity Controls
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction.

controls.title: Person or Entity Authentication
controls.description: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to ePHI is the one claimed.

controls.title: Transmission Security
controls.description: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
